newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - July 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - July 10.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait Airlines resumes flights to Amman after a six-year halt.
- Subscription in one billion dirham Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank ends on Thursday.
- Water and electricity directorate in Abu Dhabi signs a 264 million dirham contract with an Indian firm to build a power line.
- Iraq receives medical assistance from Syria.
- Saudi Arabia and China agree to set up new joint projects.
- Lebanon bought oil worth $303 million in the first five months of this year.
- United Arab Emirates plans to increase its investments in Egypt.
